_comment: Accepted codegen-differential defects, per (component, attribute, platform, check). An entry means the converter demonstrably fails that judgement and the failure is accepted FOR A STATED REASON — not that it is fine. Unrecorded defects fail `jui conformance gate --codegen-effect`; entries the measurement no longer supports are stale and fail too, so fixing a defect forces its row out (the one-directional version lets a fixed row sit here forever, which is how the previous freeze ledgers rotted). Advisory classes (value-is-default, numeric-string-divergence) are re-derived every run and are deliberately absent. Reason 'unreviewed-initial-measurement' marks the initial-measurement backlog — consume it.

entries.owner: E (SSoT) — contract, no implementation is owed on this face
entries.reason: Contract, not a gap. The collectionSeparators ruling (2026-08-07, raised by B) settles it: the ios probe path is CollectionStackView, not SwiftUI's List, and a container that draws no separators satisfies 'hide the separators' VACUOUSLY. 'Implement it' must not mean 'switch the container to a List' — an attribute that reshapes the thing it modifies is the defect family this wave exists to remove. The coverage row is runtime-only: the ios DYNAMIC path implements it; no codegen face does, by contract.

entries.owner: E ruling — vacuous outside List (see reason)
entries.reason: Ruled 2026-08-07 (51-E, asked by B): a container that is not a List has no separator to hide — the only separator emission on any face is the List path, and the probe layout does not reach it. Contract is a vacuous no-op outside List contexts; coverage marks the attribute runtime-only. Do not read this row as an implementation gap.
